technique_de_realisation: Slice steak and grill lightly in oil. Divide in two pans.
Sauté onions and celery in corn oil and add to steak.
Make a roux with margarine and flour.
Add tomatoes and beef stock to roux, stir until thickened and smooth.
Pour over steak, cover and put in oven at 350 F for 2 hours.
Variation - Pepper Steak: Omit tomatoes and add 2 cups green pepper instead.
